name: crof-copilot-chat
description: Use hosted CrofAI coding models in GitHub Copilot Chat with your CrofAI API key.

crofCopilot.inlineSuggestions.description: Experimental. Provide ghost-text inline completions while typing, powered by the CrofAI gateway with reasoning_effort none. Credentials, prompts, and document context are never logged.

crofCopilot.inlineSuggestionsModel.description: Model id used for inline completions. glm-5.3-flash measured cleanest (zero hidden reasoning at effort none); kimi-k2.6, kimi-k3-eco, greg-2 models, and qwen3.5-9b are not recommended for ghost text.

crofCopilot.inlineSuggestionsChatInput.description: Also offer inline completions inside the Copilot Chat prompt box.

crofCopilot.inlineSuggestionsDebounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds between typing and an inline completion request.

crofCopilot.inlineSuggestionsTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for inline completions.

crofCopilot.inlineSuggestionsMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

crofCopilot.inlineSuggestionsPrefixLines.description: Lines of document context sent before the cursor.

crofCopilot.inlineSuggestionsSuffixChars.description: Characters of document context sent after the cursor.

enumDescriptions: Use less reasoning for lower latency and cost.
Balance reasoning depth, latency, and cost.
Use deeper reasoning for complex tasks.
crofCopilot.reasoningEffort.description: Default CrofAI reasoning effort. A Copilot model-picker selection overrides this value.

crofCopilot.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from CrofAI hosted models. Use 0 to use the selected model's advertised maximum.

crofCopilot.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of a CrofAI inference request in seconds.

crofCopilot.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time without receiving streamed CrofAI response data before aborting a request.

crofCopilot.catalogCacheMinutes.description: How long the CrofAI hosted-model catalog is reused before refreshing.

crofCopilot.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show the active CrofAI account credit balance and request allowance in the status bar.

crofCopilot.debugLogging.description: Log request, stream, usage, and model-discovery metadata to the CrofAI output channel. Prompts and API keys are never logged.

apiKey.title: CrofAI API Key
apiKey.description: API key for this CrofAI provider entry. VS Code stores configured secrets securely.
